featuredResource.title: Wet Woods: Flux, Flex & Change in Our Forestry
featuredResource.description: This book follows northeastern loggers, foresters and mill operators adapting to changing weather, labor and markets. Their accounts give readers an on-the-ground view of seasonal uncertainty, equipment decisions and the practical costs of keeping wood moving while protecting land and water.
